title: Practice Kriya Yoga Every Day | Sri Mrinalini Mata

# Practice Kriya Yoga Every Day

### Sri Mrinalini Mata • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving blessings. Sri Mrinalini Mata emphasizes the absolute importance of consistency of our daily spiritual practice. "Practice Kriya Yoga every day," she directs. If we wish to transform our lives, we must establish a regular, uninterrupted routine of deep communion with the Divine.

### Overcoming Ego-Lethargy

The restless mind will always find excuses to delay or skip meditation. But a day without meditation is like a day without the fresh air of the soul. When we prioritize our spiritual path, the Guru's grace flows to assist us in overcoming all physical and mental restlessness.

### Magnetizing the Spine

Daily practice of Kriya cleanses and magnetizes our subtle centers of energy. Over time, the lower centers of restlessness are quieted, and the energy remains naturally anchored in the high state of peace and intuition.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Morning Devotion:** Establish your meditation routine before checking any phones or digital devices.
* **Never Skip:** Even if you can only sit for a short time, keep your scheduled hours sacred.
* **Keep a Journal:** Double-check your spiritual habits weekly to keep on track.
* **Patience:** Do not be anxious for results; focus on loving your daily effort.

May you stay faithfully attuned. Jai Guru!
